create_ResultCache: create a ResultCache instance with a cache directory, cache name, logger, and path manager
load_ResultCache_load: load cached results from disk using ResultCache.load with optional gather across ranks
save_ResultCache_save: save arbitrary data to a per-rank pickle cache file using ResultCache.save
check_ResultCache_has_cache: check whether a cache file already exists using ResultCache.has_cache before loading
review_ResultCache_cache_file: review the ResultCache.cache_file property to inspect the per-rank pickle file path
